pages.text: $(bold)Fixed Client Defaults$()$(br2)This version has no client configuration file; these behaviors are fixed in code.$(br2)• Reload bar: HOTBAR, fading after completion$(br)• Fire-control panel: AUTO, with horizontal and vertical offsets of 0$(br)• Camera shake: default strength

$(bold)Note$()$(br2)These defaults cannot currently be changed through a client configuration file. The Debug Terminal offers its existing debug controls and torpedo/core speed overrides, not general client parameters or CSV configuration.
